meta.purpose: Field-level inventory: which data in legacy generated pages (pokechan_data.js / pokechan_data_all.js / items_database.js) cannot be derived from master/*.json today.
meta.method: node full-count scripts against live repo files (no sampling). Repo not modified.

TYPE_KANJI.note: 1-char kanji abbreviation per type (ノ/炎/水/...). Not in master/types.json (only name+color). Static 18-row table, easy to add.

TYPE_DISPLAY.note: Truncated display label for 6 long type names (ノーマル→ノーマ etc). Not in master/types.json. Static table.

TYPE_OFFENSIVE_STATS.note: Per-type {p,m,x} counters (physical/special/mixed move-count stats used by a UI widget). Not in master/types.json. Static table, values unchanged since Champions data.

DEFAULT_TYPE_ORDER.note: Fixed display order of the 18 types for a UI selector. Not in master. Static array.

POKEMON_LIST.legacy_only_root_cause: hankaku-alphanumeric-rule violations + English form-slug residue not covered by reference/_name_normalize.json (NAMEMAP). Not a data gap, a name-matching gap.

fields.name: derivable — master.name (already merged/official)
fields.weight_kg: derivable — master.weight_kg (many null in both; same coverage)
fields.resist: derivable — master.resist (or computed from type1/type2 x TYPE_CHART, verified formula reproduces stored array)

season.note: Array = which past+current regulations this Pokémon appeared under. master/pokemon.json has no season field, only a single current-tense 'regulation' (M-B or null) and 'champions' bool. master/regulations.json explicitly does NOT retain history ('過去レギュの行は残さない'/'後戻りしないため' — see regulations.json meta.note). The M-A leg of the [M-A,M-B] history (218 rows) is not reconstructable from master today.

key_order.rule: ascending move_no — verified: legacy object insertion order and master/moves.json array order both strictly non-decreasing by move_no.

fields.description: derivable — regenerate via tools/_waza_compose.js compose(entry) from master.battle_data (composeDescH logic already ports 1:1; see tools/build_national_view.js:194-218)
fields.battle_data: derivable — master.battle_data (already the exact same object, built by direct passthrough)

learners.note: reverse-index of master/learnsets.json[].learn by move JA name. Not stored in master/moves.json itself (by design — avoids duplicate data direction).

subcategory.note: Not stored in master/moves.json. Derivable via subcatFromEffects(battle_data) (ported verbatim from tools/build_national_view.js:221-252) for rows where master doesn't already carry one — but master has NO subcategory field at all today (0/919), so this must be recomputed at generate-time, not read.

availability.note: NOT in master/moves.json (0/919 have it). Derived in legacy from an external file reference/_showdown/moves.json (Pokemon Showdown moves.json gen+isNonstandard fields) joined by move id/slug, via deriveAvailabilityAll() in tools/_build_pokechan_data_all.js:52-64. That external Showdown-derived source itself is not part of master/*.json and was never migrated in. Needed for gen-availability badges.

text_diff_vs_master.effect_ja.note: National ABILITY_DESC is 'house-style' short JA text (compressed, e.g. '毎ターンすばやさ+1。'). master/abilities.json.effect_ja is intentionally sourced from the Champions authority scrape (yakkun /ch/) when available — longer, game-accurate official wording (e.g. '毎ターン、『すばやさ』ランクが1段階ずつ上がる。'). See tools/build_master_v2.js:180-185 (`if (au && au.effect) effect = au.effect`). This is a DELIBERATE content upgrade per CLAUDE.md ('ABILITY_DESC は公式準拠なのでそのまま可'), not a bug — but it means the OLD verbatim house-style wording cannot be reproduced from master; a new generator using master will change ~99% of ability text on the page.

row_count.note: STAT_RANK is NOT expanded to the full 1219 in pokechan_data_all.js — it is Champions' 275-entry table passed through unchanged (tools/build_national_view.js:69 `const STAT_RANK = C.STAT_RANK;`). So ~78% of national-only Pokémon have NO STAT_RANK entry in the legacy data either.

STAT_RANK.master_presence: NOT in master/*.json at all (no file, no field).
STAT_RANK.formula_verified: hp_a (level-50, max EV/IV) = floor((2*base_hp+31+63)*0.5)+60 — verified exact match for フシギバナ base_hp=80 → 187 (matches stored value). atk/def/etc use the standard Lv50 stat formula with nature multiplier; base_rank fields are percentile ranks of the stat within the same POKEMON_LIST population (also recomputable, order-dependent on which population you rank against).
STAT_RANK.conclusion: Fully computable from master/pokemon.json stats (hp/atk/def/spatk/spdef/spd/total) via the documented Lv50 formula — no unique legacy content, but must be reimplemented (formula + ranking logic) since master stores none of it.

cosmetic_form_filtering_rule.note: isCosmetic() filter (COSM regex + signature match against default-form dex-mate) that trims 1302→1219 lives only in the builder JS (tools/build_national_view.js:100-112), not as a stored master field. Reproducible by re-running the same regex/signature logic against master/pokemon.json, but the *decision* per-row is not persisted (no is_cosmetic field in master).

POKEMON_LIST_row_order.note: Order is NOT simple no-ascending (see multi-form dex-no groups e.g. ビリリダマ appears at idx99 (no100, 通常) AND again at idx1177 (no100, ヒスイ) far apart). Empirically the array is: [pass1: one row per dex-no 1..1025 in ascending order, using each species' PokeAPI-default variety] + [pass2: idx~1025-1055: extra non-region/non-mega formes (Deoxys/Wormadam/Shaymin/Arceus/etc), ascending by no] + [pass3: idx~1056-1123: all Mega forms, ascending by no] + [pass4: idx~1124+: region-variant forms GROUPED by region label in order アローラ→ガラル→ヒスイ→パルデア, each group ascending by no]. This bucket order is inherited from the raw input array order of reference/pokeapi_master.json / reference/master_pokemon.json (i.e. PokeAPI's own varieties fetch order), NOT computed by a documented sort key. master/pokemon.json instead sorts (no, then name localeCompare) — flat, no bucketing — so master's current order does NOT reproduce the legacy display order. A new generator must either (a) preserve/restore the original fetch-order field, or (b) explicitly re-implement the 4-pass bucket rule, or (c) adopt a new (flat no+name) order as an intentional page redesign.

pokechan_data_js_champions_only_fields.note: pokechan_data.js POKEMON_LIST rows (313) carry everything pokechan_data_all.js rows carry PLUS 170 extra boolean/numeric columns not present in the national schema.

cnt4/cnt2/cnt1/cnthf/cntqf/cnt0/cnt42/cn.note: Pure aggregate counts over the `resist` array (count of 4x/2x/1x/0.5x/0.25x/0x weaknesses+resists; cnt42=cnt4+cnt2, cnthfqf=cnthf+cntqf). Verified byte-exact reproduction from resist[] for sample row. CRUCIALLY: pokemon_db_v9.html itself IGNORES the stored JSON values and recomputes them client-side on load via recalcResistCounts() (pokemon_db_v9.html:1561-1574), so these 8 stored fields are already functionally unused/redundant in production.

okatazuke.note: Only non-boolean 'move flag' column (numeric, always 0 in sampled rows). Needs a follow-up look at what non-zero values (if any exist) mean before deciding derivability.

170_per_move_boolean_flags.purpose: Used by pokemon_db_v9.html's per-move filter-checkbox columns (buildWazaTh / wazaFilterGet, lines ~2144-2987) — 'does this Pokémon learn move X' for a curated subset of (mostly status) moves. Keys are move `key` (romaji slug) values from WAZA_MAP.
170_per_move_boolean_flags.runtime_note: At page init(), pokemon_db_v9.html additively re-derives these from POKEMON_WAZA (`moveKeys.forEach(k=>{p[k]=true})`, pokemon_db_v9.html:4149-4155) — but only ADDS true, never resets to false. So the baked JSON value is the floor.

cross_check_vs_master_learnsets_json.unresolved_concentrated_in: 34 Pokémon, nearly all Champions-custom Mega forms not backed by an official movepool (メガライチュウX/Y, メガラグラージ, メガシビルドン, メガタイレーツ, メガクチート, メガカラマネロ, etc. — see full per-name breakdown available on request).
cross_check_vs_master_learnsets_json.conclusion: master/learnsets.json is MORE complete than legacy C.POKEMON_WAZA for real Pokémon (resolves 699/867 = 81% of the gap), but for ~34 bespoke Champions Mega forms, the pre-baked legacy flags encode learnset knowledge not present anywhere in master today — genuinely legacy_only (168 flag-instances).

master_only_items: ガブリアスナイトZ (all manual_addition 2026-09-01, M-C preview mega stones)

field_map.key→slug, name, name_en, category, effec: derivable — direct field rename, 1:1 in master

acquisition/acquisition_note.note: How the item is obtained (shop/VP cost/route). Not in master/items.json. No equivalent field at all.

restriction.note: Free-text usage restriction (e.g. 'ピクシー のみ装備可能' for mega stones). Not in master; master.applies_to_pokemon captures the mega-stone-target subset of this but not restrictions on non-mega items.

notes.note: Free-text curator notes/caveats. Not in master (master has a generic 'note' field used for pokemon.json, not items.json).

q12/factor/source_q12.note: Internal calc-tool identifiers (q12 = presumably a lookup index into a damage-calc spreadsheet 'vgc-champions-calc'; factor = numeric multiplier). Not represented in master (master.boosts is a category string like 'physical_attack', not a numeric factor).

verify.note: Boolean QA flag (all 169 items have this key set true/false). No equivalent in master.

boost_type/vp_cost/resist_type/trigger/c.note: Structured battle-mechanic sub-fields (analogous to moves' battle_data) for specific item categories (berries/type-resist berries/status-cure berries/VP shop items). No equivalent structured field in master/items.json at all — master only has a single free-text effect_ja plus the generic applies_to/applies_to_pokemon/boosts triplet.

heal_amount_fixed/heal_fraction/heal_fra.note: Sparse (1-3 items each) but genuinely structured sim-mechanic numbers with zero master representation. If a new items sim/battle_data field is ever added to master (mirroring moves.battle_data), these are the seed values to carry over.

mega_form/mega_target_en/mega_types/mega.note: For the 75 mega-stone items, these fields duplicate what's already derivable by joining item.applies_to_pokemon → the matching mega-form row in master/pokemon.json (mega_form≈that row's name, mega_types≈type1/type2, mega_stats≈hp/atk/def/spatk/spdef/spd) and mega_ability/mega_ability_desc → master.ab1..3 + master/abilities.json.effect_ja. mega_ability_desc specifically is a short paraphrase (e.g. 'マジックコートで跳ね返せる変化技を相手に跳ね返す') that will NOT text-match master/abilities.json's authority-sourced effect_ja (same house-style-vs-authority mismatch documented above for ABILITY_DESC).

pokeapi_slug.note: 18 items only. Likely redundant with master item slug in most cases; worth a follow-up 1:1 diff before declaring truly unique.

pokemon.legacy_only_cause: full-width digit/percent normalization gaps + English form-slug residue (hankaku-alphanumeric-rule)
